frozen: input embeddings (retain vocabulary and reduce CPU optimizer state)
data: fixed random subset of campaign19 public human revision/FEVER replay training; exclude normalized source page, claim and passage overlaps with validation/calibration-fit

screen_gate: raw accuracy improves>=0.02 OR provisional correct-definitive improves>=0.02; raw regression<=0.01; coverage regression<=0.02
